writeup: TIC 469789979 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 2.1214 days. The primary eclipse causes the system to dim by 3.59%, detected with a signal-to-noise ratio of 138.5 using automated analysis of TESS photometry. A secondary eclipse was not detected. Pixel-level image analysis shows a difference-imaging peak signal-to-noise of 5.6, though the centroid offset of 7.5 arcseconds from the target warrants attention when evaluating this result. The candidate does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, making it a novel find. The machine-learning screening assigned this target a score of 0.58 on a scale where higher values indicate greater confidence in the automated pipeline's assessment.
